text: Learn to feel when you have had enough. The process of enjoyment has a beginning, a peak, and a completion. Learn to recognize the point where “pleasant” turns into “too much.” This applies to food, rest, communication, work, and of course sex. Stopping in time is not self-prohibition but a form of respect for yourself and for the source of pleasure, allowing you to avoid surfeit, dependence, “obesity,” disgust... At a deeper level of understanding, this is about the yoga practice (principle) called Brahmacharya. This practice leads to liberation from desires. That is, desires remain, but it is no longer they who control you; you control them, like a team of horses.
